name: 陳怡倩
objective:
This course aims to introduce the foundational principles of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies. It provides learners with a conceptual and practical grounding in research design, enabling them to conduct methodologically sound explorations and investigations across both paradigms. Furthermore, the course examines the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the research process—highlighting their applications in data collection, transcription, coding, and analysis—to enhance research efficiency, accuracy, and depth.
本課程旨在介紹質性與量化研究方法的基本原理，並為學習者提供研究設計的概念基礎與實務能力，使其能夠在兩種研究範式中進行方法嚴謹的研究。此外，課程亦將探討人工智慧（AI）工具於研究歷程中的應用，包括在資料蒐集、轉錄、編碼與分析等階段的整合運用，藉此提升研究的效率、準確性與深度。
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1 Course Introduction
Week 2 AI Tools for Research; Finding a Research Topic
Week 3 Mid-Autumn Festival (no class)
Week 4 Library Resources; Ethics in Research
Week 5 Make-up day off for Double Tenth Day (no class) 
Week 6 Qualitative Research Design
Week 7 Qualitative Sampling & Data
Week 8 QRD I: Phenomenological Study
Week 9 QRD II: Ethnological Study
Week 10 QRD III: Case Study
Week 11 AI tools for Qualitative Data Analysis
Week 12 Quantitative Research
Week 13 Quantitative Sampling & Data
Week 14 Quantitative Research Design: Paired T-test Stud, Independent T-test Study, & Correlation Study
Week 15 Mixed Methods Research Design
Week 16 Constitution Day (no class)
Week 17 New Year's Day (no class)
Week 18 Final Project Due; Final Project Presentations
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 遠距教學 (Distance learning)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          In the final week, students will synthesize their learning into a formal, recorded online presentation pitching their proposed research design and methodology. Each student is required to produce a comprehensive, 10-minute video presentation that articulates the trajectory of their investigation. The presentation must explicitly detail the core research questions, theoretical framework, choice of qualitative, quantitative, or mixed-methods paradigms, data collection and analysis protocols.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Upon completion, students will be able to articulate a methodologically sound research proposal in spoken English with academic precision, while effectively engaging in constructive peer review.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          40%
